item.name: Track a deep link open event

request.description: This endpoint is used to track when a user opens your app via a Dub-powered deep link (for both iOS and Android).

response.name: The response from the tracked open event.

The server cannot or will not process the request due to something that is perceived to be a client error (e.g., malformed request syntax, invalid request message framing, or deceptive request routing).
Although the HTTP standard specifies "unauthorized", semantically this response means "unauthenticated". That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.

The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is unauthorized, so the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401 Unauthorized, the client's identity is known to the server.
The server cannot find the requested resource.
This response is sent when a request conflicts with the current state of the server.
This response is sent when the requested content has been permanently deleted from server, with no forwarding address.
The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.
The user has sent too many requests in a given amount of time ("rate limiting")
The server has encountered a situation it does not know how to handle.
